description: A WPF WebView2 app throws DllNotFoundException for WebView2Loader.dll at runtime because the native runtimes folder is missing from the deployed app, from https://stackoverflow.com/questions/71855131/system-dllnotfoundexception-unable-to-load-dll-webview2loader-dll-the-specifi.
prompt:
The WPF screen works in Visual Studio, but our copied release folder crashes when the WebView opens.

```
System.DllNotFoundException: Unable to load DLL 'WebView2Loader.dll' or one of its dependencies: The specified module could not be found. (0x8007007E)
   at Microsoft.Web.WebView2.Core.CoreWebView2Environment.CreateAsync(...)
```
